scores.evidence: All three objectives are can-do statements, and each has 3 or more graded items with objectiveId (o1: q1, e1, e2; o2: q2, q3, e3, e4; o3: q4, q5, e5, e6). o1 is 'create / 設計できる', but every o1 item asks the learner to pick a ready-made check. q5 (o3) mostly tests whether the learner asks for an explanation, not the sorting itself (see mustFix).

hook-lead is a concrete scenario in 3 sentences ('「完了しました。正しく動作します」…翌日、別の入力でエラーが出ました') followed by the predict item q0, with no trivia. The keyed option b is the only option that mentions a check, so the item is easy to guess rather than predict, and it is tagged o2 although it asks about giving a check (o1).

Prerequisites are listed, and s1-why recalls the 第1回 agentic loop. 'ターン' is used in s2-goal ('ターンごとに別の小さなモデルが判定し'), s2-goal-prompt and e2 ('20ターンで止める') but is never defined here or in cc-01 to cc-03 (grep finds no 'ターン' in cc-01 or cc-02), so the brief's assumption does not hold. 出力スタイル is used in s5-styles one block before its definition in s5-defs.

Lint shows 0 warnings, and every segment has a table, prompt, diagram or quiz. Two sections hold two ideas each: 4-2 covers evidence and /goal, and 4-4 has 10 blocks covering fresh-context review, the over-engineering trap, sorting and the /review alias, plus '過剰設計' on top of 3 defined terms.

In 4-3 (role example), s3-steps gives 5 labelled subgoals, each with its reason ('失敗を先に見ると、テストが新しいコードを試しているとわかります'), followed by both prompts and the test code. The practice repeats the same flow on a new function with fewer explanations. The red and green expectations it models are wrong for the files it describes (see accuracy).

Every content section ends with an inline quiz, and the items are at apply, analyze or evaluate level (q1 header vs design image, q3 edited expected value, q4 boundary bug at 5,000円), with feedback on every wrong option. q1's key echoes the table's wording ('撮って元の画像と比べて' becomes '結果を撮って画像と比べ'), so it can be answered by matching words.

All 7 misconceptions in the brief appear as distractors with short corrective feedback (e.g. q0 a 'returns the same Claude's self-report', e2 d 'the evaluator does not run commands', q3 a 'changing the expected value lets a wrong implementation pass'). e4 option d ('次からは報告を短くするよう頼む') is a filler distractor, and q5 option a's feedback blames the wrong cause.

s4-sort is a 5-node process diagram whose labels use the text's own terms (正しさ, 要件, 必須, 任意). Its caption states the takeaway ('必須にするのは、正しさと要件に関わる指摘だけ'), and its alt text is descriptive. s1-table compares checks; there are no decorative images.

The practice is an authentic hands-on task in a safe throwaway folder (p-setup) with 8 steps, each with an expect, plus hints and troubleshoots, a 7-item checklist (p-checklist) and a model answer (p-model-code, p-model-sort). Some expects will not match what the learner sees: p-write ('すべて失敗します') and p-evidence ('差分は実装のファイルだけ') fail for the reasons in the accuracy mustFix, and 'pass 4' assumes exactly 4 tests.

summary-points (5) comes after the exam. summary-next asks a reflection question ('手元のタスクに、どの確認を渡せますか。') and names 第5回. There are 7 flashcards that test retrieval rather than copy the text, plus askTutor.

The tool version is pinned in the subtitle, and claims are cited (cc-goal, cc-code-review-local, ai-skills-rct 50%対67%). Three factual errors: (1) s3-prompt-write expects '4件すべてが失敗' while 'the implementation file is still empty or missing', but with no export `node --test` reports one file-level load failure, not 4 failed tests. (2) ex-evidence expects `git diff --stat` to show 'postal.mjs だけ', but postal.mjs is untracked after the tests-only commit, so `git diff --stat` does not list it. (3) s1-table and q1 present 'take a screenshot and compare it' as a check Claude runs by itself, without saying it needs a browser tool.

The lesson uses です・ます consistently and is non-pressuring, lint finds no banned phrases, and terms match the glossary (検証, 証拠, テストファースト, サブエージェント). In places the wording repeats itself ('「結果を確かめる」を確かにする方法' in s1-why); the ja-editor owns that.

The lesson is jp only and complete. The diagram has a caption and alt text, and the only link has descriptive text ('[日本語の公式ドキュメント](https://code.claude.com/docs/ja/best-practices)'). No text is baked into images.

mustFix.issue: The worked example's red step is wrong. With postal.mjs missing or empty (expect: '実装のファイルはまだ空か、ありません'), the import `{ isPostalCode } from './postal.mjs'` fails, and `node --test` reports one file-level failure ('fail 1'), not '4件すべてが失敗'. A load error also does not show that the tests exercise the function, which is the reason given in ex-red. The brief's verified 'fail 4' only holds with an exported empty function.
mustFix.fix: In s3-prompt-write.prompt, replace the line 'まだ実装はしないでください。テストを実行し、失敗することを見せてください。' with '`postal.mjs` には、中身が空の `export function isPostalCode() {}` だけを置いてください。テストを実行し、4件とも失敗することを見せてください。' Change expect to '仕様の1行ごとにテストが1件ずつ書かれます。`postal.mjs` は空の関数だけで、実行すると「fail 4」になります。' In s3-steps, change ex-write.md to '仕様は例で渡し、実装は空の関数だけにします。', ex-commit.title to '③ テストと空の関数をコミットする' and ex-commit.expect to 'テストと空の関数だけのコミットができます。'

mustFix.issue: ex-evidence expects '差分は `postal.mjs` だけで', but in the current flow postal.mjs is a new untracked file after step ③ ('テストだけのコミット'), and `git diff --stat` never lists untracked files. The learner sees empty output and cannot tell whether that is right.
mustFix.fix: Apply the s3-prompt-write fix so the empty postal.mjs is committed with the tests in step ③. Then `git diff --stat` lists only postal.mjs, and ex-evidence.expect can stay as it is. If the empty-function approach is not used, change ex-evidence.md to '`git status` で、テストのファイルが変わっていないことと、新しい `postal.mjs` を確かめ、自分でも実行します。' and its expect to '変わったのは新しい `postal.mjs` だけで、4件とも成功します。'

mustFix.issue: The practice repeats both errors. p-prompt-write asks for tests only, so p-write's expect 'テストができ、すべて失敗します' turns into a single load failure. p-evidence's expect '差分は実装のファイルだけで' does not match `git diff` when the implementation file is untracked. Practice success criteria the learner cannot reproduce undermine the self-check.
mustFix.fix: In p-prompt-write.prompt, after '{{テストの道具}}で、テストだけを書いてください。', add '実装のファイルには、中身が空の `isLeapYear` だけを置いてください。'. Change p-prompt-write.expect to '`leap-year.test.mjs` のようなテストと、空の関数だけの `leap-year.mjs` ができます。2024・2023・1900・2000のような年で、仕様を1件ずつ確かめるテストです。実行すると、すべて失敗します。' In p-steps, change p-write.expect to 'テストと空の関数ができ、テストはすべて失敗します。' and p-commit.title to '③ テストと空の関数を読んでコミットする'.

mustFix.issue: The table row 'スクリーンショット比較 … 「撮って元の画像と比べて」' and the q1 key present a screenshot comparison as a check Claude can run by itself. Claude Code can only take a screenshot of a page when it has a browser tool. o1 hinges on 'Claudeが自分で実行できる確認', so a learner who tries this in a plain terminal session will find it does not work.
mustFix.fix: Add a markdown block 's1-screenshot-note' right after s1-table with cite ['cc-best-practices']: '画面を撮るには、Claudeがブラウザを操作できる道具が要ります。公式ガイドが挙げる方法を確かめてから使いましょう。' After checking the guide's wording, name the tool it gives. In q1.prompt, add 'Claudeはブラウザを操作できます。' before '渡す確認として…', so the keyed answer is valid as written.

mustFix.issue: 'ターン' is never defined in this lesson or in cc-01 to cc-03 (the brief assumes 第1回 introduced it, but cc-01 and cc-02 do not contain the word). The /goal mechanism ('ターンごとに別の小さなモデルが判定') and e2's '20ターンで止める' depend on it.
mustFix.fix: In s2-goal.md, replace 'ターンごとに別の小さなモデルが判定し、満たすまでClaudeは続けます。' with 'Claudeが応答を1回終えるたび（1ターンごと）に、別の小さなモデルが判定し、満たすまでClaudeは続けます。'. In the glossary entry '/goal', replace 'ターンごとに' with '応答を1回終えるたび（1ターンごと）に'.

mustFix.issue: q5's stem says the learner cannot judge a finding about full-width digits. Option a's feedback blames that on not understanding the change ('判断できないのは、変更をまだ理解していないサインです'). By the lesson's own rule (p-model-sort: '仕様にない入力' is 任意), the real gap is that the requirement does not say how to handle full-width digits. The feedback teaches a wrong diagnosis, and the item does not cleanly test o3's sorting.
mustFix.fix: Change q5.prompt to '郵便番号の関数に「全角の数字が通らない」と指摘が来ました。指摘の意味がよくわからず、必須か任意か判断できません。次の一手はどれでしょう？'. Change option a's feedback to '迷う指摘まで直すと、過剰設計につながります。まず意味をつかみ、要件と照らします。'. Change the explanation to '仕分けるには、指摘の意味と、要件に関わるかがわかる必要があります。説明させて意味をつかみ、要件に全角の数字の扱いがあれば必須、なければ任意です。'

mustFix.issue: e4 option d ('次からは報告を短くするよう頼む') is a filler distractor that no learner holds. Its feedback ('報告の長さは問題ではありません') corrects nothing, which breaks the contract rule that every wrong option encodes a real misconception, and leaves e4 with effectively 3 options.
mustFix.fix: Replace e4 option d's md with 'ビルドが通ったので、念のためテストも実行させてから受け入れる', and its feedback with 'テストを足しても、無視した型エラーは残ったままです。まず確認を弱めた設定を戻します。'

niceToHave: hook-predict q0: set objectiveId to 'o1', since the question is about which check to give. Make the distractors more tempting, for example option c '「テストも書いて」と一言だけ足す', so the prediction is less obvious.
s5-defs: move this block above s5-styles so 出力スタイル is defined before it is first used.
check-quiz e2 option b: align it with the lesson's own rule that the evaluator only reads the conversation and with s2-goal-prompt, e.g. '「`npm test` の出力が「fail 0」になる。テストのファイルは変更しない。または20ターンで止める」'.
p-steps p-green.expect and p-prompt-green.expect: the pass count depends on how many tests Claude wrote. Use '出力が「fail 0」になります（passの数は、書かれたテストの数です）。'
s1-check q1 option b: avoid echoing the table's wording, e.g. '「直した画面と届いた画像を見比べ、ずれを挙げて直して」', so the item cannot be matched to s1-table by words.
s3-pitfall: attribute the quote precisely: 'Anthropicも長時間動くエージェントの実験で、テストの削除や編集は「許されない」と指示しました。'
prerequisites: pin the runtime used for the examples, e.g. 'Node.js 18以降（例はNode.js 22で確認）'. node:test is not available in older versions.
o1 is at create level, but it is only assessed by selection. Add a practice step '⑨ 手元のタスク1つに、渡す確認と依頼文に足す一言を書く' with a matching checklist item, so the learner designs a check at least once.
4-4 is the heaviest section. Consider moving s4-names (the /review alias) into the glossary entry only, which already carries it, so the section ends on the sorting idea.
summary: Strong structure: every segment has an apply- or evaluate-level inline check, the 4-3 worked example comes before a faded practice, the sorting diagram is exemplary, and all 7 misconceptions from the brief appear as distractors. The most important fix is the test-first walkthrough itself: with a missing or empty implementation file, `node --test` shows one load failure instead of 'fail 4', and `git diff --stat` does not list the untracked postal.mjs. Commit an empty exported function with the tests, in both the example and the practice. Also define 'ターン', say that screenshot checks need a browser tool, rework q5's feedback, and replace e4's filler distractor.
